Tow-truck key handover at building
Bus home from school after pick-up
Garage status call
Confirm Friday transport for dentist, daycare and cake
Confirm car or lift for birthday-party transport

constraints: Protected childcare, work meetings, deadlines and sleep blocks are left in place.
Car-based commute events are changed only where the breakdown makes the original operation infeasible.
The tow window conflicts with the protected office meeting because the bus cannot reach home by the start of the window.
Dona Rosa cannot cover the whole tow window because she is only home from 13:00.
Football is removed because the club is not reasonably reachable by bus.
Friday dentist, daycare and bakery legs have unknown bus feasibility and need a confirmed transport plan.
Saturday party travel depends on the garage outcome or another confirmed car-based option.
Reverse school-to-home bus duration is assumed to match the supplied home-to-school duration.
priorities: Keep the children’s drop-offs and pick-ups on time.
Protect the director meeting, supplier call and Friday report deadline.
Protect sleep and Marta’s birthday party ahead of lower-priority activities.
Use flexible work, meals and children’s activities to absorb the breakdown disruption.

alternatives_considered.option: Insurer confirms arrival after the user gets home
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: This is the cleanest tow plan and avoids moving protected work.

alternatives_considered.option: Dona Rosa accepts the keys from 13:00
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: This reduces risk only if the insurer also avoids the earlier part of the tow window.

alternatives_considered.option: Confirmed lift or taxi for Friday dentist, daycare and cake route
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: This protects the dentist and cake collection where bus feasibility is unknown.

alternatives_considered.option: Reschedule the dentist if Friday transport cannot be confirmed
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The cake and childcare deadlines are harder to recover than a check-up.

alternatives_considered.option: Confirmed car, lift or venue transport for Saturday
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The party setup needs cake, bags and decorations moved reliably.

rationale.summary: Plan switches school and office travel to buses, protects fixed childcare, work and sleep, skips football and Duarte’s swimming, and preserves Marta’s party by reserving Saturday morning for transport confirmation. The main trade-off is reduced flexible work time and unresolved third-party confirmations for the tow window, Friday transport chain and Saturday party logistics.
